apps.localizedDescription: Watch Kick lives with chat, multi-view, channel VODs and clips, search, categories, followed channels and go-live notifications.

versions.localizedDescription:
- English is now the main language, with French when the iPhone is in French (or chosen in Settings)
- Multi-view: watch up to 4 lives side by side, tap one to hear it
- Landscape player with the chat on the side
- Picture in Picture keeps playing when you leave the player
- Live viewers and title refreshed every minute, live duration, and a notice when the stream ends
- Sleep timer and maximum video quality
- VODs resume where you stopped, with their progress on the channel page
- Chat badges, replies, optional timestamps, text size, a "Latest messages" button, and a button to hide the chat
- Home shows your followed channels that are live and the channels you watched recently; language and 18+ filters
- Channel page: banner, About tab (bio, socials, recent categories) and clip sorting
- Search also finds categories; the category list can be filtered
- Long-press a live to follow it, add it to multi-view, share it or open it on kick.com
- Notifications when a followed channel goes live (checked in the background when iOS allows it)
- New Settings tab
